title.narrative: Harnessing Anticipatory Action outcomes for resilience building in Gwanda South

description.narrative: The project is part of upscaling the Early Action for Impact (START NETWORK FUNDED), now Code 1 funded, to strengthen building of knowledge repository, sharing and community engagement in Gwanda South, Zimbabwe, to bolster resilience against climate-related shocks. Focusing on vulnerable communities, including women, children, youth, and persons with disabilities, the project aims to address the disproportionate impact of climate-related shocks on these groups. To achieve this, the project will document best practices, establish community-based platforms, and provide training programs for community members and local institutions. Furthermore, the project will develop an evidence-based plans feeding into the national framework. The project anticipates several outcomes, including enhanced anticipatory actions, improved knowledge sharing, and a developed framework for national resilience strategies. The project will also have a distinct impact on target groups. Women will gain improved access to climate-resilient initiatives, enhanced decision-making, participation, and reduced risk of gender-based violence. Children and youth will benefit from improved access to education on disaster risk reduction and enhanced community participation. Persons with disabilities will experience improved access to inclusive initiatives, enhanced decision-making participation, and reduced social exclusion. Aligned with the National Development Strategy 1 and the Sendai Framework, the project will enhance knowledge sharing and community engagement, contributing to improved resilience against climate-related shocks and promoting sustainable development in Zimbabwe .
